integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic surreal body horror, photorealistic. <Subject 1> stands facing the camera in a tiled changing room at a public swimming pool, framed from the chest up, the middle of the forehead bare and clearly visible. The camera pushes in at slow speed. A faint spiral crease appears in the skin of the middle of the forehead. The crease deepens into overlapping curved flaps of skin that rotate outward in one smooth motion, exactly like the blades of a camera iris, and a perfectly round opening widens to the size of a coin, then of a palm. There is no blood and no wound; the edges are clean, soft and alive. Inside is a smooth dark cavity far deeper than the body could hold. <Subject 1> stares at it, breath held, and the rim of the aperture slowly contracts and relaxes like a pupil adjusting to the light. In the final moment the aperture closes again, leaving only a small spiral scar.

overall_soundscape: Quiet room ambience, held breath, a soft sliding of skin over skin as the aperture turns open, and a faint hollow air tone from inside.
